{{Quote|When that's done, I have a special treat for you children. To celebrate my son's return, you're all invited to an Alderaanian Ceremony of Waters.|[[Aryn Dro Thul]]|<ref name="DA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ceremony of Waters''', also known as the '''Ceremony of the Waters''', was an [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] tradition practiced by the [[Dro family|Dro]] and [[House of Thul|Thul]] families. It was a ceremony of peace, so all invited to attend had to leave any and all weapons behind.

The ceremony began with one person humming a tune, then placing their hand into a fountain and letting the water run over it, with the others joining in. Guests were then given glasses to fill with water from the fountain, and there were speeches given about the life-giving properties of water.
